source_text: Allegations of evidence gaps, particularly regarding sexual function and sensitivity, are countered by higher-quality studies, including RCTs and meta-analyses, which find no significant detriment to penile sensitivity, sexual satisfaction, or function post-circumcision; one review of rigorous trials reported equivalent or improved outcomes in circumcised men for sensation and orgasm ease. [46] [127] [35]
